Step 3. The affine operator \(V_{01370013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle V_{01370013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the polynomial convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01370011 \cdot C_01370012 \cdot C_01370013\).
